# About this guide

This guide explains how to use the SS Innovations Events website at **events.ssistudios.com**.

- **Part A** is for attendees: finding an event, booking, managing your ticket and arriving at the venue.
- **Part B** is for SS Innovations staff and administrators: creating events, managing bookings, checking people in, reports and user accounts.

Numbered orange markers on each screenshot match the numbered steps beside it.

> **Tip:** The website works on any phone, tablet or computer. Attendees do not need an account or password.

# Part A. Attendees

## A1. Find an event

1. Open **events.ssistudios.com** on your phone or computer.
2. Choose a category: **SMRSC**, **MantraM** or **CME / Workshop**. Each card shows how many events are open for registration.
3. On the category page, tap the event you want to attend.

![Step 2: choose a category](a01-home.png) ![Step 3: open an event](a02-category.png)

> **Note:** SMRSC registration takes place on the conference website. The SMRSC page will link to it as soon as registration opens.

## A2. Book a time slot

Most events ask you to choose a time slot.

1. On the event page, check the dates and venue, then tap **Book a slot**.
2. Fill in the registration form: your title and full name, specialty, mobile number, email, hospital and location. Fields marked with an asterisk are required.
3. Tap **Continue to Time Slots**.
4. Choose a date.
5. Choose a time that shows seats left, then tap **Confirm booking**.

![Step 1: Book a slot](a03-event.png) ![Step 2: registration form](a04-form.png) ![Step 3: continue](a05-form-continue.png)

![Step 4: choose a date](a06-slots.png) ![Step 5: choose a time and confirm](a07-slot-confirm.png)

> **Tip:** Times that have already passed or are full cannot be selected. If a slot fills while you are choosing, you will be asked to pick another.

## A3. Register for an event without time slots

Some events do not use time slots. After filling in the form you will see **Confirm your registration** instead of a list of times.

1. Check the event name, dates and venue.
2. Tap **Confirm registration**.

![Confirm registration for an event without time slots](a14-register-only.png)

Your ticket is valid at any time on the days of the event.

## A4. Your ticket

As soon as your booking is confirmed:

- You see a confirmation on **My Tickets** with your booking reference.
- We send a copy of your ticket, including the QR code, to the email address you entered.

From your ticket you can:

1. **QR Ticket**: open the ticket to show at the venue.
2. **Add to Google Calendar**: add the booking to your calendar.
3. **Reschedule**: move to another time slot.
4. **Cancel booking**: release your place.

![Booking confirmed](a08-mytickets.png) ![Ticket actions](a09-ticket-actions.png)

To keep your ticket on your phone, open **QR Ticket** and tap **Save ticket**. The ticket is saved as an image.

![Save ticket](a10-ticket.png)

> **Tip:** Keep your **booking reference** (for example SSI-EV-2026-…). You need it to open your ticket on another device. It is shown on the ticket and in the email.

> **Note:** If the email does not arrive within a few minutes, check your junk or spam folder. The sender is tickets@events.ssistudios.com.

## A5. Open your ticket on another device

1. Tap **My tickets** at the bottom of the screen.
2. Enter the mobile number you registered with.
3. On a new device, also enter your booking reference.
4. Tap **View tickets**.

![My Tickets look-up with mobile number and booking reference](a13-lookup.png)

On the phone you booked with, your tickets usually appear automatically.

## A6. Reschedule a booking

1. Open **My tickets** and find your booking.
2. Tap **Reschedule**.
3. Choose a new time with seats left, then confirm.

![Reschedule: choose a new time](a11-reschedule.png) ![Cancel: confirm the cancellation](a12-cancel.png)

Your booking reference and QR code stay the same. We email you the new time.

> **Important:** You can reschedule or cancel only before your slot starts and before you have checked in. For events without time slots you can cancel until the event ends; rescheduling does not apply.

## A7. Cancel a booking

1. Open **My tickets** and find your booking.
2. Tap **Cancel booking**.
3. Tap **Cancel booking** again to confirm (shown above, right).

Your place is released for someone else, the QR code stops working, and we email you a confirmation.

## A8. At the venue

- Show the QR code on your phone (or a printout, or the email) to the event staff.
- Check-in opens **15 minutes before** your time slot.
- If you arrive early or late and another slot has free seats, staff can move you into it and check you in.

## A9. Common questions

| Question | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| I didn't receive the email | Check junk or spam. You can always open your ticket from **My tickets** with your mobile number and booking reference |
| I lost my booking reference | It is in the confirmation email. If you no longer have it, ask the event staff; they can find your booking by name or mobile number |
| My slot is full | Choose another time, or another date if the event runs over several days |
| An event says "Fully booked" | All places have been taken. Check back later in case places are released |
| The event was cancelled | We email everyone who booked. Your ticket shows "Cancelled" and is no longer valid |

# Part B. Staff and administrators

## B1. Sign in

1. Go to **events.ssistudios.com/admin/login**.
2. Enter your **login ID or email address**.
3. Enter your password and tap **Login**.

![Admin sign-in](b01-login.png)

> **Important:** After five wrong passwords within 15 minutes, the account is locked for 15 minutes. If you have forgotten your password, ask a superadministrator to reset it.

> **Note:** You are signed out automatically after 8 hours.

## B2. What you can access

Your menu shows only the sections you have been given:

| Section | What it is for |
| --- | --- |
| Dashboard | Today's figures, latest bookings, upcoming events |
| Events Management | Create, edit, cancel and delete events |
| Bookings | Find, view, edit and delete bookings |
| Check-in | Scan tickets at the venue |
| Reports & Export | Attendance figures and attendee lists for download |
| Analytics | Website visits and app ratings |
| User & Access | Staff accounts and the activity log (superadministrators only) |

Within a section, **create** rights allow adding and editing, and **delete** rights allow cancelling and deleting.

## B3. Dashboard

The dashboard opens after you sign in.

1. **Menu**: move between sections.
2. **Operational overview**: total events, events live today, bookings, today's check-ins and free seats.

![Dashboard](b02-dashboard.png)

Below are the latest bookings and the next events with how full they are. The page updates on its own.

## B4. Create an event

1. Open **Events Management** and select **New Event**.

![Events Management](b03-events.png)

2. Enter the event name, venue, description and image, and choose the **category** (SMRSC, MantraM or CME / Workshop).

![New event: event details](b04-new-event.png)

> **Tip:** Choosing MantraM selects the matching registration form automatically. You can still choose another form.

3. Choose the **Booking type**:
   - **Time slots**: attendees choose a time; check-in follows their slot.
   - **Registration only**: no time slots; one ticket valid for the event days. You can set a registration limit or leave it blank for no limit.

![Booking type](b05-booking-type.png)

4. For time slots, set each day's schedule: start and end time, lunch break, slot length, gap between slots and **seats per slot**. The preview shows the slots attendees will see.

![Daily schedule](b06-schedule.png)

5. Select **Create Event**. The event appears on the website straight away.

## B5. Edit, cancel or delete an event

- To edit, open the event in **Events Management** and select **Edit Event**. Save your changes.
- Times that people have booked cannot be moved or removed, and a slot's seats cannot be reduced below the number already booked.
- The booking type and timezone cannot change once people have registered.

To remove an event, select **Cancel event** (or delete):

| Event | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Nobody has booked | The event is deleted |
| People have booked | The event is cancelled: bookings are kept, tickets show "Cancelled", and **every attendee is emailed**. Staff receive one summary email |

> **Important:** Cancelling an event with bookings cannot be undone. Check the event name before confirming.

## B6. Manage bookings

1. Open **Bookings**. Search by name, email, mobile, hospital or booking reference, or use the filters (event, date, status, attendance and more).
2. **View** a booking.
3. **Edit** attendee details.
4. **Delete** a booking. This frees the seat.

![Bookings list](b07-bookings.png)

On a booking's page you can correct details and **mark the attendee present or not present** at any time.

![Booking details](b08-booking-detail.png)

> **Note:** "Pending" rows are people who filled in the form but did not choose a time. They have no ticket. You can delete them if needed.

## B7. Check attendees in

1. Open **Check-in** and choose today's event.
2. Select **Start Camera** and point the camera at the ticket's QR code. Allow camera access when the browser asks.
3. Without a QR code, type the booking reference instead.

![Check-in scanner](b09-checkin.png)

![Manual check-in by booking reference](b09b-checkin-manual.png)

The result appears straight away:

| Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Marked present (green) | Checked in |
| Ticket verified | Already checked in earlier; nothing else to do |
| Not their booked time (amber) | The attendee is early or late. If any slot open now has seats, it is listed |
| Ticket not accepted (red) | Wrong event, cancelled event or unknown ticket |

**Early or late arrivals:** select one of the listed slots, for example **Check in to 15:30–16:00**. The attendee is moved into that slot and checked in in one step.

![Moving an early arrival into an open slot](b10-checkin-early.png)

> **Tip:** Check-in opens 15 minutes before each slot. For events without time slots, tickets are accepted at any time on the event days.

> **Note:** You can check in only events that are live today. The attendance figures on the right update as people arrive.

## B8. Reports and export

1. Open **Reports & Export**.
2. Filter by event, registration dates and attendance.
3. Download the attendee list as **CSV**, **Excel** or **PDF**.

![Reports](b11-reports.png)

The report shows bookings, attendance rate, QR and manual check-ins, seat use, and figures per event.

## B9. Analytics

**Analytics** shows website visits for the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days: page views, visitors, how many reach each booking step, which events are viewed most, where visitors came from, and the devices they use. **Live** shows who is on the site now. App ratings and comments from attendees appear at the bottom.

## B10. Staff accounts (superadministrators)

1. Open **User & Access** and select **Add User**.

![User & Access](b12-users.png)

2. Enter the person's name, login ID, email (optional, lets them sign in with it) and a password of at least 12 characters with upper-case and lower-case letters and a number. Use **Generate** for a strong password.
3. Choose the role and the sections they can open, and whether they can create and delete.

![Adding a user](b13-user-form.png)

4. Save. The password is shown once: copy it and send it to the person securely.

To change access, reset a password or deactivate someone, edit the user. Changes apply immediately; a password reset signs them out everywhere.

> **Important:** At least one active superadministrator must always remain, and you cannot change your own role or deactivate yourself.

The **Admin Activity Log** on the same page lists every sign-in, failed sign-in and change, with who made it and when. Filter by person, action or date.

## B11. Help

| Situation | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| Forgotten password | Ask a superadministrator to reset it |
| Camera does not start | Allow camera access in the browser settings, or use manual check-in |
| Attendee has no ticket | Search **Bookings** by name or mobile, then mark present from the booking page |
| A section is missing from the menu | Ask a superadministrator to grant access |
| Staff copies of emails not arriving | Check junk mail; your IT team can allow events.ssistudios.com as a trusted sender |
